purpose: One row per capability from the comprehensive research report's gap analysis (fifteen): best source + its licence as recorded at study time, the standing verdict, and this tree's current status. Maintained with scripts/wiki_capability_register.py.

capability: A hosted door: remote, multi-agent, multi-device access
status: Not built. This tree's doors are local: a stdio MCP read door (tools/mcp-read, 8 read verbs, read-only) and the local gateway (tools/gateway). A hosted door is a custody decision (Tier C in the programme record), parked for the owner's ruling.

capability: Truth-aware retrieval: superseded facts withheld, with reasons
status: Built in the search engine: scripts/wiki_search.py applies the severance register (evaluation/retrieval-severance.json, built by scripts/wiki_severance.py) after every ranking stage — results on severed pages, and results carrying a severed claim the query itself hunts, are withheld, and the exclusions are reported with their register entries (excluded[]: path + entry ids) in the CLI and evidence-pack output. Pinned by scripts/tests/test_wiki_search_severance.py (25 tests).

capability: Learned reranking and hybrid retrieval at scale
status: Partially built. The swappable reranker seam stands (scripts/wiki_rerank.py, W1.1) with the deterministic coverage reranker as default; the dense-fusion trial (evaluation/dense-trial-report.md, W1.2) found fusion gains nothing on this corpus and it was not adopted. No learned reranker or model provider is wired; wiring one is owner-gated.

best_source.name: galileo-ai/ragbench
best_source.licence: not shown on the opened page text (catalogue listed cc-by-4.0)

status: Built. tools/ask/sentence_scoring.py (W3) scores answer sentences against their packed evidence, and scripts/wiki_factscore_check.py checks each cited claim's lexical support at its cited passage (content-token overlap; supported / unsupported verdicts; report-only, never auto-verifies).

capability: Evaluation over tables, images and the whole lifecycle
status: Partially built. Lifecycle evaluation exists as task definitions (evaluation/crud-lifecycle-tasks.json, checked by scripts/wiki_crud_tasks.py: answer after ingest, after superseding ingest, abstain after tombstone), and the synthetic slices score table-carried questions (evaluation/synthetic-slices-report.json). Image-carried evaluation has no media corpus to bite on in this tree.

capability: Scored abstention — knowing when to say "not found"

best_source.name: llmware/rag_instruct_benchmark_tester
best_source.licence: not shown on the opened page text (catalogue listed apache-2.0)

status: Machinery built — the capability the report scores at parity. The battery runner (scripts/wiki_abstention_check.py) executes a battery file against the current pipeline and the Ask suite carries abstention coverage (scripts/tests/test_abstention_coverage.py, tools/ask/tests). The standing battery data file itself is held with the private corpus this edition is extracted from; no battery file stands in this tree.

capability: Bi-temporal memory: valid-time, as-of queries, supersession without deletion

best_source.name: solu199/codex-memory-sidecar
best_source.licence: MIT License (MIT), as shown on the opened repo page

status: Not built as fields. Supersedes chains, claim as_of dating, signed checkpoints and retention recall --as-of carry this tree's time discipline; systematic valid-time fields and an as-of query surface are Phase-2 owner-gated.

capability: Approval-gated writes with a trust ledger
status: Built — the capability the report scores at parity. tools/gateway: scoped default-deny identities, staged proposals, reviewer != proposer, a hash-chained ledger; agent writes arrive as filings and land only by review.

Partially built. This tree's own converter carries the injection defences and parse-quality gating (scripts/wiki_convert.py, scripts/wiki_convert_engines.py) and a GROBID sidecar stands (scripts/wiki_grobid.py); the layout-aware engine itself (Docling) is doored on the owner's install approval, and OCR remains a queue, not a verified pipeline.

capability: Sync across devices, and handover between sessions

best_source.name: jiabaobei/memory-bridge
best_source.licence: MIT License (MIT), as shown on the opened repo page

status: Not built in its strong form — live encrypted multi-device sync was parked Tier C in the programme record. The custody half stands: git custody with HEAD-verified integration and checkpoint-export handover packages (scripts/wiki_handoff.py).

capability: Citation truth-checking against the scholarly record
status: Built (W1.3). scripts/wiki_scholar_check.py resolves the scholarly citations the corpus carries against Crossref and OpenAlex — DOI/title/author mismatches, fabricated identifiers and retraction signals — report-only; latest run at evaluation/scholar-check-report.json. (Scholar Sidekick, also MIT, is the second source the study opened for this capability.)

capability: Privacy masking before text reaches an AI
status: Partially built. The gateway's secrets/PII scan blocks credential-shaped content at the door and scripts/wiki_leak_lint.py scans export surfaces; deterministic name-level aliasing (the AI Alias mechanism) is not built.

capability: A pre-action warning: "you have failed at this before"
status: Built. scripts/wiki_precheck.py: before editing a page or path, one report surfaces everything the record holds about failing there — corrections-ledger entries, post-mortems and reflexion notes (report-only; pattern: projectmem, MIT).

capability: Multi-writer safety without a single-writer bottleneck

best_source.name: Dexio
best_source.licence: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)

reason: The governed single-writer gateway is this system's standing architecture: one door, filings as the multi-agent pattern, merges by review. Simultaneous multi-writer editing was expressly excluded in the programme record; the gap is accepted by design rather than missing by accident.
status: Not built — rejected by design (see reason).

capability: A machine-readable map of the whole vault
status: Built (2026-10-22, alongside this register). scripts/wiki_vault_map.py generates evaluation/vault-map.jsonl: one line per wiki page — frontmatter, outlinks, embeds, backlinks, broken links, duplicate titles, orphans. Before it, the same territory was exposed only as traversal queries (tools/traverse).
